entries.titleZh: 墨西哥共和国极权政府

en: The Centralist Republic of Mexico, officially the Mexican Republic, as the unitary regime established on 23 October 1835 under the constitution known as the Siete Leyes
Its replacement of the federal republic and its own end in 1846
zh: 墨西哥中央集权共和国正式称墨西哥共和国，是1835年10月23日依《七法》宪法建立的单一制政权
取代此前的联邦共和国，1846年终结

politics.zh: 墨西哥中央集权共和国正式称墨西哥共和国，是1835年10月23日依《七法》宪法建立的单一制政权，取代了1824年的联邦共和国。它由保守派主导，将各州改为受中央任命的部门，引发得克萨斯与北部各州的分离运动；1846年美墨战争爆发后联邦制恢复，该政权终结。
politics.en: The Centralist Republic of Mexico, officially the Mexican Republic, was a unitary political regime established on 23 October 1835 under a constitution known as the Siete Leyes, replacing the federal republic of 1824. Dominated by conservatives, it turned the states into departments run by centrally appointed officials, provoking separatist movements in Texas and the northern states; the federal system was restored in 1846 as the war with the United States began, and the centralist regime came to an end.

economy.zh: 经济以银矿、农业与关税收入为基础，中央集权削弱地方财政，使北部边境的防务与税收困难，与外国商人的借款和贸易纠纷不断增加。
economy.en: The economy rested on silver mining, agriculture and customs revenue, and centralisation weakened local finances so that defence and taxation on the northern frontier became difficult, while loans from foreign merchants and trade disputes multiplied.

culture.zh: 这一时期保守派与自由派围绕教会特权、军队与教育展开激烈争论，报刊与政论活跃，天主教会在社会生活中仍居核心地位。
culture.en: In these years conservatives and liberals argued fiercely over church privileges, the army and education, newspapers and political writing flourished, and the Catholic Church remained central to social life. Its press was closely watched by the government of the day.

events.zh: 关键节点包括1835年《七法》颁布、1836年得克萨斯独立、1838至1839年的法墨战争，以及1846年联邦制恢复。
events.en: Key moments are the promulgation of the Siete Leyes in 1835, the independence of Texas in 1836, the Pastry War with France in 1838-1839 and the restoration of federalism in 1846. The northern provinces then resumed their federal claims.

value.en: It was established on 23 October 1835 under the Siete Leyes.
Federalism was restored in 1846, ending the regime.

en: Barbados as an island nation in the Caribbean Sea and part of the Lesser Antilles
Its position as the southernmost and easternmost island of the Caribbean region
Bridgetown as its capital and largest city
zh: 巴巴多斯是加勒比海的岛国，属小安的列斯群岛
是加勒比地区最南端与最东端的岛屿
首都与最大城市为布里奇敦

politics.zh: 巴巴多斯是加勒比海的岛国，属小安的列斯群岛，是加勒比地区最南端与最东端的岛屿，位于南美板块与加勒比板块交界处，首都与最大城市为布里奇敦。国家为英联邦成员国，1966年脱离英国独立，2021年改为共和国，由总统取代英国君主作为国家元首。
politics.en: Barbados is an island nation in the Caribbean Sea and part of the Lesser Antilles, the southernmost and easternmost island of the Caribbean region, lying on the boundary of the South American and Caribbean tectonic plates, with Bridgetown as its capital and largest city. A member of the Commonwealth, it became independent from Britain in 1966 and became a republic in 2021, with a president replacing the British monarch as head of state.

economy.zh: 经济以旅游业、离岸金融服务与轻工业为基础，甘蔗与朗姆酒是传统物产，海岛位置使其成为区域航运与金融中心之一。
economy.en: The economy rests on tourism, offshore financial services and light industry, with sugar cane and rum as traditional products, and the island's position has made it a regional centre of shipping and finance. Sugar and rum still hold a place in the export trade.

culture.zh: 文化融合非洲与英国传统，英语为官方语言，卡利普索与索卡音乐、板球运动是社会生活的重要部分，种植园与奴隶制历史在国家记忆中占有位置。
culture.en: Its culture combines African and British traditions, English is the official language, calypso and soca music and cricket are important parts of social life, and the history of the plantations and slavery holds a place in national memory.

events.zh: 关键节点包括1627年英国殖民、1834年废除奴隶制、1966年独立，以及2021年改制为共和国；此后国家长期保持议会民主与两党轮替。
events.en: Key moments are British colonisation in 1627, the abolition of slavery in 1834, independence in 1966 and the change to a republic in 2021. The country has since kept a stable parliamentary democracy. Its parliament is one of the oldest in the region.

value.en: It became independent in 1966 and a republic in 2021.

value.zh: 是加勒比最南端与最东端的岛屿。
value.en: It is the southernmost and easternmost island of the Caribbean.

en: Cambodia, officially the Kingdom of Cambodia, as a country in Mainland Southeast Asia
Its borders with Thailand, Laos and Vietnam and its coastline on the Gulf of Thailand
An area of about 181,035 square kilometres dominated by a low-lying plain
zh: 柬埔寨正式称柬埔寨王国，位于中南半岛
西北邻泰国，北接老挝，东与东南连越南，西南临泰国湾
面积约181,035平方公里，以低地平原为主

politics.zh: 柬埔寨王国位于中南半岛，西北与泰国接壤，北邻老挝，东和东南与越南相连，西南临泰国湾，面积约181,035平方公里，以湄公河与洞里萨湖周边的低地平原为主，首都为金边。1953年脱离法国独立，此后经历王国、共和国与红色高棉时期，1993年恢复君主立宪制。
politics.en: The Kingdom of Cambodia lies in Mainland Southeast Asia, bordered by Thailand to the north-west, Laos to the north and Vietnam to the east and south-east, with a coastline on the Gulf of Thailand and an area of about 181,035 square kilometres dominated by the low-lying plain of the Mekong and Tonle Sap, its capital being Phnom Penh. It became independent from France in 1953 and has since passed through monarchy, republic and the Khmer Rouge period before the restoration of constitutional monarchy in 1993.

economy.zh: 经济以农业、成衣加工与旅游业为基础，稻米、橡胶与渔业是传统部门，金边与西哈努克市是工业与港口中心，外资与侨汇近年作用上升。
economy.en: The economy rests on agriculture, garment manufacturing and tourism, with rice, rubber and fisheries as traditional sectors, Phnom Penh and Sihanoukville as centres of industry and shipping, and foreign investment and remittances growing in importance.

culture.zh: 柬埔寨文化以高棉传统与上座部佛教为核心，吴哥古迹是世界文化遗产，高棉语为官方语言，宫廷舞蹈、皮影与佛教节庆延续至今。
culture.en: Cambodian culture centres on Khmer tradition and Theravada Buddhism, the monuments of Angkor are a World Heritage site, Khmer is the official language, and court dance, shadow theatre and Buddhist festivals continue to this day.

events.zh: 关键节点包括9至15世纪的吴哥王朝、1863年起法国保护、1953年独立、1975至1979年红色高棉统治，以及1993年恢复君主立宪。
events.en: Key moments are the Angkorian period from the ninth to the fifteenth century, the French protectorate from 1863, independence in 1953, Khmer Rouge rule from 1975 to 1979 and the restoration of constitutional monarchy in 1993.

value.en: It became independent from France in 1953.

en: The Kingdom of Castile as a polity in the Iberian Peninsula during the Middle Ages
Its origins in the ninth-century County of Castile, an eastern frontier lordship of the Kingdom of Leon
The growing autonomy of the Castilian counts and its separation as a kingdom in 1065
zh: 卡斯蒂利亚王国是中世纪伊比利亚半岛的政体
源自9世纪莱昂王国的东部边地卡斯蒂利亚伯国
伯爵势力日益自主，1065年成为独立王国

politics.zh: 卡斯蒂利亚王国是中世纪伊比利亚半岛的政体，源自9世纪莱昂王国的东部边地卡斯蒂利亚伯国，10世纪伯爵的自主性不断增强，1065年成为独立王国。它由本地王统与莱昂王统交替统治，在收复失地运动中向南扩张，1230年与莱昂最终联合，形成卡斯提尔联合王国，成为后来西班牙君主国的主体。
politics.en: The Kingdom of Castile was a polity in the Iberian Peninsula during the Middle Ages, tracing its origins to the ninth-century County of Castile, an eastern frontier lordship of the Kingdom of Leon. The Castilian counts grew steadily more autonomous in the tenth century and the county became a separate kingdom in 1065. Ruled in turn by its own and by Leonese royal lines, it expanded southwards in the Reconquista and was definitively united with Leon in 1230, forming the Crown of Castile that became the core of the later Spanish monarchy.

economy.zh: 经济以高原农业与畜牧为基础，美利奴羊毛贸易与城堡沿线的市镇网络是重要支柱，布尔戈斯与托莱多是商业与宗教中心。
economy.en: The economy rested on plateau farming and herding, with the merino wool trade and the network of towns along the frontier castles as important supports, and Burgos and Toledo as centres of commerce and religion.

culture.zh: 卡斯蒂利亚语在此时期逐渐成为行政与文学语言，史诗《熙德之歌》与宫廷史学奠定早期西班牙文学传统，罗马式教堂与修道院遍布境内。
culture.en: Castilian gradually became the language of administration and literature, the epic Poem of the Cid and court historiography laid the foundations of early Spanish literature, and Romanesque churches and monasteries spread across the realm. Its charters and chronicles record the growth of the realm.

events.zh: 关键节点包括9世纪伯国形成、1065年成为王国、1085年夺取托莱多、1212年纳瓦斯德托洛萨战役，以及1230年与莱昂联合。
events.en: Key moments are the formation of the county in the ninth century, its becoming a kingdom in 1065, the capture of Toledo in 1085, the battle of Las Navas de Tolosa in 1212 and the union with Leon in 1230.

value.zh: 源自9世纪莱昂王国的卡斯蒂利亚伯国。
value.en: It originated in the ninth-century County of Castile under Leon.
It was definitively united with Leon in 1230.

en: The Austrian Empire, officially the Empire of Austria, as a multinational European great power from 1804 to 1867
Its creation by proclamation out of the realms of the Habsburgs
Its rank as the third most populous nation in Europe after the Russian Empire and the United Kingdom
zh: 奥地利帝国是1804至1867年的欧洲多民族强国
由哈布斯堡家族领地宣告建立
人口在欧洲仅次于俄罗斯帝国与英国，居第三

politics.zh: 奥地利帝国是1804至1867年间的欧洲多民族强国，由哈布斯堡家族领地在拿破仑战争期间宣告建立，以回应神圣罗马帝国的解体。帝国由皇帝统治，境内包括奥地利、波希米亚、匈牙利以及意大利与波兰的部分地区，民族问题与中央集权之争贯穿其历史；1867年奥匈折衷后改为奥匈帝国。
politics.en: The Austrian Empire, officially the Empire of Austria, was a multinational European great power that existed from 1804 to 1867, created by proclamation out of the realms of the Habsburgs in response to the dissolution of the Holy Roman Empire. Ruled by an emperor, it included Austria, Bohemia, Hungary and parts of Italy and Poland, and its history was marked by national questions and disputes over centralisation; the Austro-Hungarian Compromise of 1867 turned it into Austria-Hungary.

economy.zh: 经济以波希米亚与奥地利的工矿业、匈牙利的农业和多瑙河航运为基础，19世纪铁路与工业在西部发展较快，关税同盟与重商主义政策推动内部市场整合。
economy.en: The economy rested on industry and mining in Bohemia and Austria, agriculture in Hungary and shipping on the Danube, with railways and industry developing faster in the west in the nineteenth century, and a customs union and mercantilist policy promoting the internal market.

culture.zh: 帝国境内德语、捷克语、匈牙利语、意大利语与波兰语等并存，维也纳成为欧洲音乐与医学的中心，大学与科学院推动科学与艺术发展。
culture.en: German, Czech, Hungarian, Italian, Polish and other languages coexisted in the empire, Vienna became a centre of European music and medicine, and its universities and academy advanced science and the arts. Its conservatories and hospitals were famous across Europe.

events.zh: 关键节点包括1804年帝国宣告建立、1815年维也纳会议、1848年革命、1859与1866年的战败，以及1867年奥匈折衷。
events.en: Key moments are the proclamation of the empire in 1804, the Congress of Vienna in 1815, the revolution of 1848, the defeats of 1859 and 1866 and the Austro-Hungarian Compromise of 1867. Its defeat by Prussia in 1866 hastened the compromise that followed.

value.zh: 1804年由哈布斯堡领地宣告建立。
value.en: It was proclaimed in 1804 from the Habsburg realms.

value.zh: 人口居欧洲第三，仅次于俄罗斯帝国与英国。
value.en: It was the third most populous state in Europe after Russia and Britain.

en: Fiji, officially the Republic of Fiji, as an archipelagic country in Melanesia in the South Pacific Ocean
Its position about 1,100 nautical miles north-north-east of New Zealand
Its archipelago of more than 330 islands, of which about 110 are permanently inhabited
zh: 斐济正式称斐济共和国，是南太平洋美拉尼西亚的群岛国家
位于新西兰东北偏北约1,100海里
由330多个岛屿组成，其中约110个有人常住

politics.zh: 斐济共和国是南太平洋美拉尼西亚的群岛国家，位于新西兰东北偏北约1,100海里，由330多个岛屿组成，其中约110个有人常住，首都为苏瓦。1970年脱离英国独立，1987年军事政变后成为共和国，此后经历多次政变与宪制调整，2013年宪法确立现行体制；社会由原住民斐济人与印度裔社群共同构成。
politics.en: The Republic of Fiji is an archipelagic country in Melanesia in the South Pacific Ocean, lying about 1,100 nautical miles north-north-east of New Zealand and made up of more than 330 islands of which about 110 are permanently inhabited, with Suva as its capital. It became independent from Britain in 1970, became a republic after a military coup in 1987 and has since gone through further coups and constitutional changes, the 2013 constitution establishing the present system; its society is made up of indigenous Fijians and an Indo-Fijian community.

economy.zh: 经济以旅游业、蔗糖与渔业为基础，服装加工与侨汇也有作用，维提岛与楠迪是主要经济与旅游中心，进口依赖度较高。
economy.en: The economy rests on tourism, sugar and fisheries, with garment manufacturing and remittances also contributing, Viti Levu and Nadi as the main economic and tourist centres, and a high dependence on imports. Tourism is the largest source of foreign exchange.

culture.zh: 斐济文化以原住民传统与印度裔文化并存为特征，英语、斐济语与斐济印地语均为官方语言，卡瓦仪式、舞蹈与橄榄球运动是社会生活的重要部分。
culture.en: Fijian culture is marked by the coexistence of indigenous tradition and Indo-Fijian culture, English, Fijian and Fiji Hindi are all official, and kava ceremonies, dance and rugby are important parts of social life. Rugby is the most popular sport in the islands.

events.zh: 关键节点包括1874年成为英国殖民地、1970年独立、1987年与2000年及2006年的政变，以及2013年新宪法。
events.en: Key moments are the establishment of British colonial rule in 1874, independence in 1970, the coups of 1987, 2000 and 2006 and the new constitution of 2013. Elections have been held regularly since the 2013 constitution.

value.en: It became independent from Britain in 1970.

value.zh: 由330多个岛屿组成，约110个有人常住。
value.en: It has more than 330 islands, about 110 of them permanently inhabited.
